inspected_listings.title: WordPress expert

inspected_listings.exclusion: The buyer leaves scope to a later conversation. No discrete import QA requirement or explicit compensation appears in the listing text.

inspected_listings.title: Web Site Developer – Project
inspected_listings.buyer_quote: We do not want AI-dependent web development.
inspected_listings.exclusion: The buyer expressly excludes AI-dependent development. The project also bundles migration of user records with a full Drupal-to-WordPress rebuild.

inspected_listings.title: WordPress website developer
inspected_listings.buyer_quote: The mandatory platform is WordPress using the Gutenberg block editor, Kadence Theme and Kadence Blocks.
inspected_listings.exclusion: The paid fixed-price job seeks a complete six-page build in a specified WordPress stack. The listing gives no separately purchasable catalogue CSV, migration or import QA deliverable.

scope: Official RSS capture only. The three scope exclusions were sufficient before verifying response rules or current availability.
reopening_trigger: A specific current buyer-authored listing explicitly commissioning a paid standalone catalogue CSV, migration or import QA task with a testable criterion, a permitted response route and terms compatible with disclosed AI assistance.
